presets.name: drawn (classic)
presets.description:
one group combining its shapes by union (strongest), as a classic drawn
mask did

notes: draw shapes or add AI objects here to mask an area
with the union operators, the pixels covered by any of the shapes are masked
use union (smooth) to let the feathered edges of overlapping shapes blend smoothly
use overlap (weakest) to mask only the pixels covered by all shapes

presets.name: parametric (classic)
presets.description:
one group combining its parametric channels by overlap (smooth), as a
classic parametric mask did

notes: add parametric channels here to select the area to mask, e.g. by color or brightness
with the overlap operators, only the pixels selected by all channels are masked
change the operator to union to mask the pixels selected by any channel
each operator's smooth variant makes smoother transitions between feathered areas

presets.name: drawn + parametric (classic)
presets.description:
a "drawn" group, union (strongest), and a "parametric" group, overlap
(smooth), combined by overlap (smooth), as a classic drawn + parametric mask did

notes: mask an area with parametric channels, and refine the selection with drawn shapes
start by selecting the parametric group and adding channels to it, then move on to the drawn group
with the overlap operators, only the area where the two groups overlap is masked
overlap (smooth) lets their soft edges fade together; overlap (weakest) keeps the weaker of the two
use the subtraction operator to exclude the area masked by the drawn group instead
alternatively, invert the output of the drawn group

presets.name: drawn + parametric, minus an area (advanced)
presets.description:
a drawn + parametric mask, with the elements added above it subtracted
from it

notes: subtract unwanted spill from a drawn + parametric mask
start by creating a mask in the drawn + parametric group, then add elements here to remove the spill
